metadata.title: Lionel Messi and Inter Miami feted by President Donald Trump at the White House for MLS Cup title

left: Lionel Messi and Inter Miami visited the White House on March 5, 2025, to celebrate their MLS Cup win with President Donald Trump and Inter Miami co-owner Jorge Mas.
Trump joked about his son Barron's admiration for Messi and Cristiano Ronaldo and engaged the crowd by asking who is better, Messi or Pelé, ultimately praising Messi's achievements.
Inter Miami co-owner Jorge Mas gifted Trump club memorabilia including a pink jersey, soccer ball, and watch while discussing the club's growth since Messi joined in 2023.
Trump welcomed Messi and the club into the Oval Office, praising Messi's winning record and the team's 2025 achievements, calling the office 'the center of the world'.
center: President Donald Trump hosted Inter Miami, the 2025 Major League Soccer champions, at the White House to honor their victory, where he praised star player Lionel Messi and made some comments about Cuba and Iran.

Inter Miami co-owner Jorge Mas spoke about the team's 'winning culture' and praised Messi as 'the world's greatest player', saying the team can now 'play with the big boys' after their championship run.

Trump asked the crowd if Messi was better than Pele, praised the U.S. military's actions against enemies, and welcomed Messi to the White House, noting he could have chosen any team in the world but picked Miami for the good weather.
right: Inter Miami CF and Lionel Messi were honored at the White House by President Donald Trump for winning the 2025 MLS Cup, where Trump called Messi better than Pelé and praised the team's achievements.
Former baseball player Alex Rodriguez attended the ceremony and was acknowledged by Trump as a fan, alongside other officials.
During the event, Messi presented Trump with a pink Inter Miami jersey and a signed soccer ball, while Trump recalled watching soccer legends and praised current players.
Trump also discussed ongoing military actions in Iran and efforts to stabilize oil prices during the celebration of Inter Miami's victory.
